module: "Get Vehicle Data" node (category `repeat_instant`), obsolete: "replaced by Get Vehicle Data, Vehicle OOBB and Vehicle Wheels". Reads `map.objects[vehId]` and the vehicle geometry. Outputs: `active`, `damage`, `dirVec`, `dirVecUp`, `rotation`, `position` (refnode), `corner_FR/FL/BR/BL`, `wheelCenter`, `velocityVector`, `velocity` (m/s). Input pin: `vehId` (default 0).
notes: The final code (`extractVehicleData`, `model`/`config` outputs) is in a commented-out block.
Crashes if the player vehicle does not exist (`veh:getId()` is not reached thanks to the `return`).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

work.desc: Fills all outputs from `map.objects` and the bounding box.
